job.value: set weekly budget, duration, campaign type and bid priority for Spotlight, then start it

arrivedFrom.value: Spotlight from the listing's seller tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The listing 'Reformation Bee midi' under 'Spotlight' followed by setup sliders says what the screen is for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Start Spotlight' button in the bottom bar is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Start Spotlight' is clear, but the 'Until I stop' chip and Priority stops '0.5x ... 3x' don't say what they change.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Reach' vs 'Volume', 'premium and app-wide placements' and '1x · Default — Match the field' are unexplained to a seller who just wants clicks.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Four sliders ask for campaign type, duration, budget and a bid multiplier, strategy calls a seller can't make with what is shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Estimated results sit below, but 'Campaign type' and 'Priority' are shown up front to every seller rather than tucked away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'You could get 3% CoinsBack with CarouBiz' upsell sits between setup and the 'Start Spotlight' button.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The sliders only make sense after reading 'Balanced — Use a blend of premium and app-wide placements.' and 'Higher priority raises your budget to win more clicks.'
